types.name: Fenrir::Colour
types.doc: A colour as linear red, green, blue and alpha, each a float, usually in [0, 1] (ADR-0025). Debug draw, materials and lights take it, and the renderer packs it for vertices. Colours written as sRGB hex values, as colour pickers and art tools give them, are converted when made (FromSrgb). Default constructed, it is opaque white.

types.name: Fenrir::FontStyle
types.doc: Whether a face is upright or italic.

types.name: Fenrir::LineMetrics
types.doc: One laid-out line of a paragraph.

fields.name: begin
fields.doc: The byte range of the paragraph's text on the line, its trailing spaces and newline included.

fields.name: top
fields.doc: The line box's top and height, in pixels from the paragraph's top.

fields.name: baseline
fields.doc: The baseline, in pixels from the paragraph's top.

fields.name: ascent
fields.doc: The largest ascent above the baseline and descent below it of the line's faces, in pixels.

fields.name: left
fields.doc: Where the line's text starts after alignment, and its width without trailing spaces, in pixels.

types.name: Fenrir::TextAlign
types.doc: Where a paragraph's lines sit across its width.

values.name: Start
values.doc: Left in a left-to-right paragraph, right in a right-to-left one.

values.name: End
values.doc: Right in a left-to-right paragraph, left in a right-to-left one.

values.name: Auto
values.doc: From its first strong character (Unicode's rule P2), left to right if it has none.

types.name: Fenrir::WhiteSpace
types.doc: How a paragraph treats spaces, tabs and newlines, as CSS's `white-space`.

values.name: Normal
values.doc: Spaces, tabs and newlines collapse to one space, and lines wrap at the width.

values.name: NoWrap
values.doc: Collapsed as Normal, on one line.

values.name: Pre
values.doc: Every space is kept (a tab as one space), newlines break lines, and lines never wrap.

values.name: PreWrap
values.doc: Kept as Pre, and lines wrap at the width.

types.name: Fenrir::ParagraphStyle
types.doc: How a paragraph's lines are laid out.

fields.name: align
fields.doc: Where the lines sit across the width.

fields.name: lineHeight
fields.doc: A line's height as a multiple of its largest font size; zero means its fonts' own height (ascent, descent and line gap). The space above the tallest glyphs and below is split evenly, as CSS's half-leading.

fields.name: maxLines
fields.doc: The most lines laid out; zero means no limit.

fields.name: ellipsis
fields.doc: Whether text cut off (by maxLines, or past the width on a line that does not wrap) ends its last line with an ellipsis, `…`, in the style there.

fields.name: whiteSpace
fields.doc: How spaces, tabs and newlines are treated.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: The base direction, which Start and End alignment follow.

types.name: Fenrir::Rect2D
types.doc: A rectangle in local 2D coordinates: logical units from the top-left, Y down.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptText::Paragraph
types.doc: A paragraph of styled text that a script made (Paragraph.Create) and the engine keeps until the script destroys it: plain data, so copying it does not copy the paragraph. Its calls lay it out in the app's FontLibrary and read back its size, lines and hit positions. Ids are never handed out again, so a destroyed paragraph's calls do nothing. The default paragraph names none.

types.name: Fenrir::TextDecoration
types.doc: A line drawn with a run of text, as CSS's `text-decoration-line`. FenrirText only reports it.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptText::TextStyle
types.doc: How one run of a paragraph's text looks, but its family, which a call takes as text.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: The font size in pixels: the em square's height. A paragraph a painter draws is laid out in the target's pixels: the style's size times the root scale times the target's pixels per unit.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: The weight asked for, 100 to 900; the family's nearest face is used.

fields.name: style
fields.doc: Upright or italic; a family without the style uses its other faces.

fields.name: letterSpacing
fields.doc: Pixels added after each glyph that advances. Not zero turns ligatures off.

fields.name: decoration
fields.doc: The line drawn with the run.
